questions.stem: Who owns the control flow in a coding agent?
options: The model
The program
Both the model and the program
Neither the model nor the program

questions.stem: What is an agent according to the text?
options: A model using tools in a loop
A model that can only run code
A program that runs without feedback
A model that runs without tools
questions.source_quote: An agent is a model using tools in a loop.

questions.stem: What is the role of the feedback loop in an agent?
options: To run the model without checks
To ensure the model's output is correct
To provide the model with more tokens
To increase the model's temperature

questions.stem: What is the harness in an agent?
options: The model itself
The code that runs around the model
The feedback loop
The tool loop
questions.source_quote: The harness is everything that is not the model.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the V-model in working with agents?
options: The model writes the code
The agent writes the code
The harness writes the code
The user writes the code
questions.source_quote: You write the spec and the checks. The agent writes the code.
